gloss: eastern part; the east (of a region)

definitions.gloss: eastern part; the east (of a country or region)
definitions.explanation: The eastern area of a country, prefecture, city or other region.

examples.english: I live in the eastern part of the prefecture.

examples.japanese: ⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧{東部|とうぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I studied at a university in the eastern United States.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{東部|とうぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the typhoon, the eastern part of the prefecture has suffered damage from heavy rain.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧{東部|とうぶ} / {都|と}{東部|とうぶ}: the eastern part of the prefecture / of Tokyo
- ⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧{東部|とうぶ}: the eastern United States
- {東部|とうぶ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: Eastern Time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {東側|ひがしがわ}: the east side of something (a building, a road, a line); {東部|とうぶ} is the eastern region of an area

WATCH OUT:
⟦{頭部|とうぶ}→頭部：31697_toubu⟧ (the head, in medical or technical language) has the same reading.
